name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Convexskills: AI Skills for App Development
short_description: Convexskills provides a comprehensive suite of AI agent skills and templates designed for building production-ready applications with Convex. It includes essential patterns for queries, mutations, cron jobs, webhooks, and migrations, streamlining the development process.
author: waynesutton

sections.overview:
Convexskills is an unofficial collection of structured AI skills designed to help AI assistants implement Convex best practices. It covers queries, mutations, cron jobs, webhooks, migrations, file storage, schema validation, security audits, and component authoring. The skills generate code that passes @convex-dev/eslint-plugin by default, preventing mistakes at generation time. Installation via npm CLI, npx, or manual setup supports multiple agent frameworks including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode. It includes slash commands for routing tasks to the appropriate skill.
Building production-ready apps with Convex
Implementing cron jobs for automated tasks
Creating webhooks for real-time data updates
Managing database migrations efficiently
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
